name: dsh-anthropic-oauth
description: Bridge Claude Code OAuth (Pro/Max/Team) into DSH — reads the grant from the macOS Keychain (Claude Code 2.1.x), ~/.claude/.credentials.json, or $CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN; auto-refreshes; syncs ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN; pulls the live model catalog from /v1/models; shows a live 5h/7d quota panel — without hardcoding.
author: TrueNix
